description: Dynamic Barcelona Edition – DYN-6106-01 (Canadian Hemlock) Embrace the healthy lifestyle with the Barcelona Sauna and reap the health benefits of an EMF FAR infrared sauna. Dynamic Saunas use FAR infrared waves that penetrate body tissue and help dissolve harmful substances and toxins . Low-EMF Far Infrared Sauna This sauna comes with privacy glass and a Bluetooth sound system and features Low EMF PureTech™ heating panels . These energy-efficient carbon heating panels can heat up faster and retain heat better than ceramic heaters. Every Dynamic Sauna has a lower bench and floor heater that gives therapeutic benefits and treatment to your legs and feet. Chromotherapy Lighting System Dynamic Saunas are made with environmentally friendly Reforested Canadian Hemlock wood. The Chromotherapy Lighting in this quality sauna helps to promote relaxation and improve mood. Enjoy a great sauna experience with a family member or a friend with your 2 person Low EMF FAR infrared sauna. Features Note: This sauna pl ugs into a standard US outlet – no hard wiring needed! Energy-efficient carbon infrared heating panels MP3/Aux input and two speakers Soft touch control panel for sauna air temperature Specifications 1–2 person sauna capacity Music system w/ Bluetooth capability and 2 dynamic speakers with pre-amp (no radio included) Interior and exterior LED control panel Natural Hemlock wood construction Electrical service: 120V/15amp Clasp together assembly 6 carbon heating elements Tempered glass door Interior reading/chromotherapy Lighting Roof vent Extra Details Exterior dimensions (WDH): 39" x 36" x 73" (roof overhang: add 2") Interior dimensions (WDH): 36" x 32" x 67" Sauna type: Infrared Sauna weight: 250 lbs Shipping weight: 295 lbs Ships in 1 box All Golden Designs Saunas include a 5-year Limited Warranty. View more details here. What are you waiting for? Order your 2-person Low EMF FAR infrared sauna today and experience the Golden Designs difference. Videos
